title: 3-bed apartment Clifton
description: Luxurious 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Clifton Village. This stunning property features a spacious living room with hardwood flooring, a modern kitchen with island, and a master bedroom with en-suite bathroom. Walking distance to shops, restaurants, and the Suspension Bridge.

title: 4-bed house Redland
description: Beautiful 4-bedroom family home in desirable Redland. Features include an open-plan living/dining/kitchen area, landscaped garden, off-street parking, and a garage. Close to excellent schools, parks, and transport links.

title: 2-bed apartment City Centre
address: 78 Harbourside View, City Centre, Bristol BS1 5TY
description: Modern 2-bedroom apartment with stunning harbour views. This contemporary property features floor-to-ceiling windows, a balcony, open-plan living space, and secure parking. Located in the heart of Bristol's vibrant harbourside area.

title: 3-bed townhouse Clifton
description: Elegant 3-bedroom Georgian townhouse in prestigious Victoria Square. This property retains many original features including high ceilings, sash windows, and ornate fireplaces. It offers a modern kitchen, private garden, and is just minutes from Clifton Village.

title: 2-bed house Southville
description: Charming 2-bedroom Victorian terraced house in popular Southville. Recently renovated throughout with a modern kitchen-diner, stylish bathroom, and low-maintenance rear garden. Close to North Street's independent shops and cafes, and within walking distance of the city centre.
